entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: The five-headed Soul of the World of Alara, an enormously powerful being worshiped as a hydra-god.

entities.name: Cylia
entities.description: A young elf who climbed the mountain with poison and a thorn dagger to stop Progenitus, and was blinded.

entities.name: Mayael
entities.description: The newly-appointed Anima to whom Progenitus appeared.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon who co-opted Progenitus's image to manipulate Mayael.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker whose invasion of dragons Bolas wanted countered.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose Worldsoul is Progenitus.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The shard of Alara under whose soil Progenitus slumbered.

entities.name: Sundering
entities.description: The event that separated Alara into Shards.

entities.name: Second Stirring
entities.description: Event fifteen years before the Conflux when Progenitus began to awaken.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: Mana-fueled phenomenon Bolas wished to feed.

events.summary: Millennia before the Conflux, Progenitus unleashes five storms to consume creation; Cylia wounds it with poisoned dagger, saving life on Alara though it had separated into Shards.
events.quote: Cylia dipped the dagger into the vial and flung her weapon into the being's heart

events.summary: Two heads of Progenitus wither away and it slumbers under Naya's soil.
events.quote: two of its heads withered away

events.summary: Fifteen years before the Conflux, Progenitus begins to awaken in the Second Stirring.
Progenitus appears to Mayael asking for Cylia; Bolas co-opts its image to tell Mayael to build an army against Sarkhan Vol's dragons.
events.quote: The image of Progenitus was soon co-opted by Nicol Bolas

events.summary: The reunification of Alara reawakens Progenitus.
events.quote: the reunification of Alara reawakened Progenitus

relations.quote: Progenitus is the Avatar of the Alaran Worldsoul
The poison revealed Progenitus's true nature

relations.note: wanted Mayael to counter his dragon invasion
relations.quote: to counteract Sarkhan Vol 's invasion of dragons
